predeclared_rule: Pool only archived accepted vectors that map inside the paired family's bounds.
Require an independent fine192 replay with absolute objective error <= 1e-9 on all 91 galaxies.
A coarse96 label is recorded and is not a veto.
Among points that pass the fine192 replay, choose the minimum fine192 objective.
A callback objective without an independent replay is not eligible.
